riskPolicy: Current config financial risk, hard stop, cash/allocation, exposure, loss budgets, cooldown and drawdown limits unchanged. Longer expiry and trailing exits are research-only alternatives. No production model gate is bypassed.
execution: Signals use completed UTC-aligned bars; entry at next 15m open with spread, fees, slippage and drift guards. Stop-first OHLC exits. Trailing updates from completed closes apply only to subsequent bars. No same-bar reentry.
selection: Choose at most one alternative per setup using 2024 only, ranking eligible candidates by net return. Baseline is a control, never a replacement. No parameter optimization or post-test selection.
baselineML: Run the unchanged rolling-60-day/retrain-12-hour model policy on the final 2025 period. Reuse a frozen schedule for the diagnostic-only revision, since learned rules/labels are unchanged.
limitations: Retrospective chronological holdout is new to this task, not genuinely unseen market history. Public research can reflect knowledge of these years. Six candidates create selection risk. Unsuccessful candidates stay disabled; no claim of guaranteed improvement.
